action.subsystem: External power and source-aware performance availability
action.name: Barrel AC, USB-C-only, and battery transition matrix
action.value: Nine successful exact-device sessions spanning all directed transitions and stable baselines

validation.applyResult: Confirmed: every physical transition produced the expected visible Synapse source state and the outgoing exact-device query/setter pattern described below.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed limitation: the decoded USBPcap stream contains outgoing 07/8C query forms, 0D/02 setters, and source-correlated 16-byte input reports on endpoint 0x82. Those input reports were not independently read through OpenBlade, and no independent 0D/82 response was captured, so typed firmware readback is not claimed.
validation.restorationResult: Confirmed visually: USB-C was disconnected, barrel AC was reconnected, and Synapse returned to Plugged In, Balanced, Auto with its full-power Performance and Custom options available.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed limitation: restoration was operator-correlated in Synapse and the outgoing restoration setters were decoded, but this matrix did not independently read back the restored thermal state.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Exact PID 02C6 repeatedly emitted 07/8C:0000 around physical power transitions. Battery destinations emitted paired Battery Saver/Automatic 0D/02 setters, while USB-C-only and restored full-power destinations emitted paired Balanced/Automatic setters.
Synapse showed Battery Saver and Auto on battery; Balanced and Auto with an inadequate-power warning on USB-C-only; and Balanced/Performance/Custom plus fixed-fan availability on barrel AC.
sanitizedEvidence.battery: On Battery; Battery Saver selected; Auto fan; fixed fan unavailable
sanitizedEvidence.usbCOnly: Plugged In; Balanced selected; Auto fan; Performance and Custom unavailable; inadequate-power warning visible
sanitizedEvidence.barrelAc: Plugged In; Balanced selected; Auto fan; Performance and Custom available; no inadequate-power warning

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Exact PID 02C6 endpoint 0x82 emitted 16-byte report-ID-05 messages with event byte 33 and source-correlated values 0011, 0711, and 1111. Battery and USB-C transitions repeatedly distinguished 0011 and 0711, while barrel-AC transitions emitted 1111.
sanitizedEvidence.admissionBoundary: The stable USB-C no-action session also emitted 1111 without a captured 07/8C request. These are retained as source-event candidates, not treated as independently matched feature-query replies.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: All nine listed captures targeted USBPcap2 device address 3 after visual re-verification, ended through the sentinel-driven graceful-stop path, decoded successfully, and remain private and ignored.

captures.name: Barrel AC to USB-C, including the physical cable-free interval

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Two initial sessions failed before capture readiness because a USBPcapCMD listing process was active. They contain no PCAP and remain preserved as failures rather than being relabeled or discarded.
The On Battery UI seen during the first successful session was the literal cable-free interval after barrel AC was removed and before USB-C was connected. It was not delayed USB-C recognition.

productionAdmission.identityScope: RZ09-0528, BIOS 2.02, USB 1532:02C6, HID usage 0001:0002, 91-byte feature reports

limitations: The decoded captures include source-correlated 16-byte endpoint-0x82 input reports, but they do not contain an independently matched OpenBlade 07/8C USB-C readback or an independent 0D/82 thermal response.
Synapse UI confirmation is not firmware readback and does not production-admit the observed battery or USB-C setters.

Value 0711 appears in an exact PID 02C6 source-transition input report, but that candidate event is not equivalent to a typed 07/8C readback. The generic PID 02E0 mapping must not be production-admitted for PID 02C6 until an exact OpenBlade query confirms it.
Active Synapse lighting produced unrelated 03/0B matrix writes and 03/0A polling; those commands were excluded from the power-source interpretation.
The occasional 0D/07:010102 write during AC restoration is a CPU High reapplication, not a power-source command.
Raw PCAPs, capture paths, serial numbers, and other unique identifiers remain private and uncommitted.
notes: The verified transient USB device address was 3 before every successful session, and only USBPcap2/device 3 was captured.
Every successful session used SkipServiceManagement and SkipAdministratorCheck and ended through the sentinel-driven graceful-stop path with no recorded errors.
The user-visible state was restored to barrel AC, Plugged In, Balanced, Auto. CPU Voltage Optimizer remained On at visible -1.000 and GPU Overclock remained Off.
Keyboard brightness remained Off; keyboard quick effect and logo effect remained Static.
